One month in and I'm ever happier to have joined @igalia@floss.social. As part of the two-person global strategy team, I get to help out across the organization, but right now my focus is on WPE WebKit, Servo, and Moonforge.

Each of these projects is fascinating, full of promise, and at a very different moment in their lifecycle. 

... if you ever wanna geek out about browser engines or embedded devices, I'm here for that!

https://blog.riley.pub/working-at-igalia-worker-owned-tech/

#OpenSource #FOSS
